sources.title: AlignTune | Tools | Lexsi Labs
sources.snippet: AlignTune is a modular post-training alignment toolkit that helps you take a base LLM and tune it into a dependable, policy-aware assistant. It brings the full alignment workflow under one roof, from supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to preference optimization and RL-style training (including methods like DPO, PPO, SimPO, and more), so you can improve instruction-following, reduce unwanted behavior ...
